For $n \ge 1$, $\lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor = k$ exactly when $2^k \le n \le 2^{k+1}-1$, which gives $2^k$ integers in each block.

Since $2^{10} = 1024 \le 2009 < 2048 = 2^{11}$, the values of $k$ that occur are $0$ through $10$. The odd values are $k = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9$:

| $k$ | Range of $n$ | Count |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | $[2, 3]$ | 2 |
| 3 | $[8, 15]$ | 8 |
| 5 | $[32, 63]$ | 32 |
| 7 | $[128, 255]$ | 128 |
| 9 | $[512, 1023]$ | 512 |

All these blocks lie entirely within $n \le 2009$, so the total is $2 + 8 + 32 + 128 + 512 = 682$.

ANSWER: 682
